criterion.title: Regression detection function implemented
criterion.requirement: `detect_regressions()` compares current discrepancies against resolved bugs
Returns list of `Regression` objects when matches found
Matching criteria: same layer + same event + similar value ranges

criterion.title: Regression model
criterion.requirement: `original_finding`: reference to the resolved bug finding
`current_discrepancy`: the new discrepancy that matches
`fixed_at`: when the original bug was fixed
`regression_detected_at`: current timestamp

criterion.title: Regression reporting in CLI
criterion.requirement: Display prominent warning when regressions detected
Show original finding ID, fix date, and description
Explain what might have caused regression
Require action before proceeding

criterion.title: Regressions block session completion
criterion.requirement: Session cannot be marked complete with unresolved regressions
Regressions must be either re-fixed or re-classified
Clear path to resolution provided in CLI

criterion.title: Regression detection in comparison workflow
criterion.requirement: Automatically run `detect_regressions()` after layer comparison
Integrate with `rustybt-validate compare` command
Report regressions before other findings

criterion.title: Unit tests verify
criterion.requirement: Regression matching logic
CLI warning display
Session completion blocking
Integration with comparison workflow
